response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile generalist engineer, but the profile does not match this role's core requirements. Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (plus a thesis project), far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ required. There is no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a fintech for company formation/investment administration, not capital markets), and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth. Recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms.
strengths: Solid engineering fundamentals with TDD, CI/CD, and low-latency systems experience (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Broad polyglot background including some C/C++ and systems-level work
Strong communication skills evidenced by workshops, talks, and training courses
concerns: Lacks the mandatory 5–10 years of professional C++ on Windows; last C++ role ended in 2015
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience (skills list MongoDB/MySQL/generic SQL)

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and CI/CD skills
